The '''Imperial Hotel''' was located in [[Tasariq City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The [[Tasari]] cult leader [[Garuk]] maintained a suite in the [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], funded by selling his cult's collection of [[tasar crystal]]s.<ref name="J15" />
